contract_gaps.current_code: Only exact nofollow token sets occurrence.nofollow; ugc/sponsored alone remain false and are admitted if other gates pass.
contract_gaps.desired_acceptance: Explicit policy for ugc/sponsored and internal/external overrides; recommended qualified-link suppression under an opt-in versioned profile, retaining originals.
contract_gaps.decision_required_before_claim: Do not silently change serialized B9 v1 config/checkpoint meanings. Establish legacy/default behavior and additive config/profile or migration contract first.
contract_gaps.runtime_status: NOT_PROVEN; source-derived baseline prediction, not executed runtime evidence

contract_gaps.current_code: Resource HTTP Link-header relationships append nofollow=false; identical HTML link rel="canonical nofollow" sets true.
contract_gaps.desired_acceptance: Preserve parsed header rel qualifiers and apply the same explicit qualification policy to equivalent relationship declarations, or document a deliberate source distinction.
contract_gaps.decision_required_before_claim: Freeze source-specific qualifier provenance and exact reason before fixing/testing.
contract_gaps.runtime_status: NOT_PROVEN; source-derived baseline prediction, not executed runtime evidence

contract_gaps.current_code: Legacy redirect guard allows same_scope OR check_external OR any resource-origin allowlist, regardless of immutable grant role; native policy path bypasses this ordinary resource-origin guard and uses policy redirect decision.
contract_gaps.desired_acceptance: Every actual hop must have both a relevant immutable original role grant and the applicable resource/navigation scope; navigation checking must not turn resource allowlists into arbitrary navigation rights, nor check_external into a wildcard resource-origin allowance.
contract_gaps.decision_required_before_claim: Define mixed-grant OR scope and initial-input redirects; never infer request role from response MIME or expansion booleans alone. Existing grant flags do not fully distinguish check-only navigation from assets.
contract_gaps.runtime_status: NOT_PROVEN; source-derived baseline prediction, not executed runtime evidence

semantic_decisions.current_v1: rel/document nofollow suppress every eligible resource and navigation occurrence; CSS/PDF/header rows have no rel flag, but page directives can suppress their descendants.
semantic_decisions.recommendation: Prove and document current own-v1 blanket behavior. If navigation-only or per-kind behavior is desired, define a new backward-compatible profile rather than claim browser/vendor equivalence.

semantic_decisions.current_v1: Document directives use indexability_agent; robots.txt uses transport user_agent. These can intentionally differ.
semantic_decisions.recommendation: Preserve and prove both independent controls; no implicit derivation from current request UA.

semantic_decisions.current_v1: Navigation expand=true grants navigation/resources (and conditionally PDF), but not standalone CSS expansion. A navigation target whose response is text/css cannot import descendants without a separate CSS or initial-input grant.
semantic_decisions.recommendation: Test this explicit role/MIME cross-control; avoid introducing response-MIME-based permission upgrades.

semantic_decisions.current_v1: X-Robots facts are extracted on terminal nonredirect response; earlier redirect headers are overwritten and do not become terminal-source document nofollow.
semantic_decisions.recommendation: Test 302-only versus terminal-only directives and preserve unknown redirect metadata; do not fabricate inheritance across hops.

primary_sources.bounded_note: Published vendor settings group nofollow, sponsored and ugc, plus meta/header page nofollow. This is a documented feature gap for current literal-only qualification, not runtime parity proof.
Public page rules support generic/scoped meta and X-Robots headers, restrictive combinations, and none=noindex+nofollow. They require access to the response before observation.
Google describes nofollow/ugc/sponsored qualification and independent discovery through other links. This is not a deterministic browser fetch prohibition or a vendor execution trace.
Public HTTP Link serialization/context/relation definitions inform source-specific fixture design; no browser/vendor request or implemented parser completeness claim.
